name: Melting Pot (DeepMind)
description: Melting Pot is a suite of 50+ multi-agent 'substrates' (games and scenarios) with rich social dynamics including cooperation, competition, deception, reciprocity, and trust. Agents interact in shared environments with persistent effects, and test scenarios pair trained agents with novel 'background populations' to evaluate generalization beyond training partners. It serves as a gold-standard benchmark for multi-agent RL generalization and social intelligence in dynamic group settings.
general_score_metric: per-substrate reward; Melting Pot score (normalized across substrates)
reputation: Gold-standard MARL benchmark from DeepMind; 50+ substrates; widely cited for evaluating social intelligence and generalization to novel partners; used in cooperative AI research.
notes: Novel partner generalization is the key evaluation principle — agents must adapt to unseen background populations. Substrates include commons harvesting, prisoner's dilemma, and collaborative cooking. Extensible to human-in-the-loop and LLM-based agents via multi-agent prompting interfaces.
